other.tags: Orchestral cinematic action score. Staccato string ostinatos in violins and violas play repetitive sixteenth-note patterns. Low brass including trombones and tubas perform rhythmic, accented stabs on the downbeats. A driving percussion section features taiko drums, orchestral bass drum, and sharp snare hits. High-pitched woodwind trills and short flute runs punctuate the transitions. The arrangement utilizes a constant crescendo with layering of horns and trumpets playing a heroic, rising minor-key motif. 140 BPM. D minor. 4/4 time signature.

bass.tags: Lo-fi hip hop featuring a sampled acoustic piano melody with heavy vinyl crackle and hiss. The piano plays a repetitive four-bar loop of jazz-influenced chords with a slight swing. A programmed drum kit consists of a muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp, dry snare with a short decay. The bass is a deep, sub-heavy sine wave that follows the root notes of the piano progression. A subtle, high-pitched synth pad provides atmospheric texture in the background. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C minor. The mix is characterized by a narrow stereo field and a warm, saturated frequency response typical of analog tape emulation.
